subject: Request: Executive sign-off for Artemis renewal concession syndicate
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: URGENT: Exec clearance request — Artemis renewal concession syndicate

Team,

Following today's renewal call with Artemis (Jordan & Pauline included), we are at imminent risk of churn without a non-standard package. Summary: they are declining the current renewal because of recurring latency incidents last quarter (2x sustained degradation) plus a sharp price push from competitor X. They asked for a single counter that aligns economics and reliability assurances.

Ask: I need executive sign-off for the package below to close by 11/16. If we don't move, they will sign elsewhere.

Proposed concession package (one-time, limited):
- 20% discount on first-year renewal ARR (applies to subscription portion only)
- One-time SLA makegood credit equal to 12% of annual committed spend (capped at $250,000) if incidents repeat in next 6 months
- Term reset: convert to a 12-month commitment starting 12/1/2026 (current contract would have rolled out shorter billing cadence)
- Dedicated Customer Success & Support Triage for 3 months (no additional fee) to stabilize latency patterns and run post-mortem

Rationale: Revenue retention (annualized $1.6M ARR), strategic reference customer in health vertical, competitor being aggressive on price but lacks our uptime tooling. The cost of concession is smaller than losing the account plus public market risk.

Risks & controls:
- This is a one-off; we will tag record as "non-standard concession — exec approved" and require renewal committee sign-off if they request extension.
- Legal to include explicit termination clause if SLA issues persist after remediation plan.

Attached: Artemis_MAT_v3.pdf (pricing), makegood-calcs-20261108.xlsx, support-transition-plan.docx

Please reply with quick yes/no and any edits. I recommend marshalling this as an "Approved with edits" motion so we can get DOCUSIGN by 11/12.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0187

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Exec clearance request — Artemis renewal concession syndicate

Marissa — thanks for the clear ask and docs. High level thoughts: I support the approach conditionally. Two items to tighten:
1) Cap the cumulative concession (discount + makegood) at $280k net impact to P&L to preserve precedent.
2) Add a 90-day technical remediation milestone schedule: if milestones not met we step down to a smaller committed tier.

If you can add that language, I'm comfortable to green-light and push to CFO for sign-off.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Sales Operations
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-09T11:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Exec clearance request — Artemis renewal concession syndicate

All,

I like the structure. I'm neutral on the exact cap but want legal to bless the SLA language before commit. Naomi, can you run the draft clause by L&C and confirm the termination trigger and credit calculation?

Also recommend we include an ROI slide for execs: expected retention NPV vs concession cost. I can knock that together if helpful.

Connor O'Brien
VP, Enterprise Sales
connor.obrien@redwood.ai

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-10T07:44:00-08:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Exec clearance request — Artemis renewal concession syndicate

I've run the draft by Legal & Compliance. Key notes:
- L&C requests explicit definitions for "sustained degradation" and the measurement window (we propose 5-minute sliding windows, incident > 3% error rate for > 15 minutes counts).
- Termination trigger: 2 SLA failures within 180 days post-renewal -> Artemis may terminate for convenience with a pre-agreed unwinding fee (we propose 30% of remaining term).
- Makegood credit formula: (monthly committed ARR / 12) * 0.12, capped at $250k. Legal asked we insert a one-time cap mention to avoid repeated credits.

I'll edit the clause and attach L&C redline by EOD.

-Naomi
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Hayes <j.hayes@artemishealth.com>, Pauline Rivera <p.rivera@artemishealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-12T16:04:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Artemis renewal — final concession package (pending exec approval)

Jordan / Pauline —

Thanks again for your candidness on the call. Attached is the updated summary of the concession package we've been authorized to propose to your team. This is intended as a one-time retention package to restore confidence and give us time to demonstrate improved reliability. Key points (clean summary):
- 20% first-year subscription discount (one-time, non-recurring)
- SLA makegood credit formula (12% of monthly committed ARR prorated, capped at $250k) in the event of two qualifying sustained degradations within 180 days
- 12-month term reset starting 12/1/2026
- 3-month dedicated Success & Support Triage (no additional fee)

We need to finalize legal language this week to get signatures by 11/16. Please confirm you can sign after I route the DocuSign package, or let me know if you need any clarifications.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: Artemis_MAT_v3.pdf, makegood-calcs-20261108.xlsx, support-transition-plan.docx
